Ofgem's cap rose 4% on 1 October to £1,723. Gas is up 8%. In real terms the cap is 7% higher than this time last year — and the only reason electricity isn't rising too is a VAT cut.

That's a patch, not a plan. We've got gas under our own seabed. Time to use it. 🇬🇧
